title: Epic Games switches to pure AI workflow for its Disney shooter. Both Code and Art
author: RuinousFate

comments.author: ArchivisX
comments.body:
I know in any other sub-reddit this comment would get downvoted into oblivion, but I do think that this is the right move.  More and more people are going to move into AI.  Capabilities in AI continue to advance at breakneck speeds.  In February, I was using Opus 4.6 to bridge the coding gap, but I still had to handle most of the art.  With Opus 5.5, I can feed it reference images and it can do it much faster instead.  Can I do it at an AAA level?  No, but I never could.

If we're making cleanroom copies of Adobe and Microsoft software suites, it's only a matter of time until someone puts a UE-capable engine out there that is better driven by AI.  It also gives AI developers an incentive to work with them instead of moving towards other platforms like Godot.
